4. How is encapsulation implemented in Java?
Encapsulation can be implemented using the following steps:
Declare those data members as private.
Provide public setter methods to set or modify the data.
Provide public getter methods to retrieve the data.
Apply validation inside the setter methods wherever required.
The private member prevents direct access, while the public methods provide controlled access.

Encapsulation can be understood in two ways.
Encapsulation is the process of giving controlled access to the important aspects of an object.
